_comment: Calibrated against cTrader 5.7.14 from a live --inspect dump (backtesting tab active). Backtest-path IDs are real. Elements marked needsInspect were NOT in that dump because their view wasn't open (the backtest settings popup was closed; the Optimisation tab was inactive; the post-run report wasn't shown) — capture a second --inspect with those open to finalise them. See docs/CALIBRATION.md.

AlgoTab.description: The 'Algo' item in cTrader's left sidebar.

AlgoSearchField.description: Search box above the cBots list — typing a bot name filters the list. Used as the hook for opening a specific bot (names aren't otherwise exposed to UI Automation).

AlgoInstancesList.description: The scrollable list of cBot templates + instances.

InstanceSettingsButton.description: The gear on an instance row that opens that instance's editor (Parameters + Backtesting/Optimisation tabs). AutomationId is shared, so the driver scopes the search to the filtered list.

BacktestingTabItem.description: The 'Backtesting' tab of an open cBot editor. Its children are the backtest toolbar (gear, dates, start/stop, Visual Mode).

OptimisationTabItem.description: The 'Optimisation' tab of an open cBot editor.

RealtimeSymbolText.description: Text on the realtime tab showing the instance's symbol (e.g. 'EURUSD'). Read to verify the right instance is loaded.

RealtimeTimeframeText.description: Text on the realtime tab showing the instance's timeframe (e.g. 'h1').

BacktestSettingsButton.description: Gear icon inside the Backtesting tab that opens the 'Backtesting settings' popup. Scoped to the Backtesting tab item by the driver (AutomationId 'SettingsButton_AId' is reused elsewhere).

FromDatePicker.description: Backtest range START date control (DatePickerEx). Its editable text box is a child.

DatePickerTextBox.description: The editable text box inside a DatePickerEx (child of FromDatePicker/ToDatePicker). Format dd/MM/yyyy.

VisualModeCheckbox.description: 'Visual Mode' checkbox on the backtest toolbar. Unchecked by the agent for speed.

StartButton.description: Play (▶) button that starts a backtest.

ParametersPanel.description: The flat Parameters panel (ScrollViewer). Children alternate: a label TextBlock (ParameterLabel) followed by its value control (SpinnerContent_AId Edit for numbers, ...ComboBox_AllValues_AId for enums, ...TextBox_Value_AId for free text).

ParameterLabel.description: A parameter's label TextBlock in the Parameters panel; Name is the friendly name (e.g. 'EMA Fast'). The driver matches on Name and then takes the following sibling value control.

_backtestSettingsDialog_needsInspect.description: Fields inside the 'Backtesting settings' popup (Starting capital, Commission, Apply commission automatically, Data). The popup was closed during the first inspect, so these use best-guess Name selectors and are applied best-effort. Re-inspect with the gear open to finalise.

StartingCapitalField.description: 'Starting capital' field in the Backtesting settings popup.

ApplyCommissionAutomaticallyCheckbox.description: 'Apply commission automatically' checkbox in the Backtesting settings popup.

CommissionField.description: 'Commission' field in the Backtesting settings popup.

DataModeDropdown.description: 'Data' dropdown in the Backtesting settings popup.

OptimisationParamsButton.description: Sliders icon on the Optimisation toolbar (opens the ranges/Timeframe dialog). Not captured yet — Optimisation tab was inactive during the first inspect.

OptimisationResultsGrid.description: The Optimisation passes results grid. Not captured yet — needs an inspect with the Optimisation tab active.

BacktestReportPanel.description: The post-run backtest report (net profit, profit factor, drawdown, trade stats). Not captured yet — needs an inspect right after a completed backtest.
